functions.name: register
functions.summary: Registers a value with the registry. In es2023 the value can be either a symbol or an object, in previous versions only object is permissible.
functions.signature: FinalizationRegistry.register(target: WeakKey, heldValue: T, unregisterToken?: WeakKey): void

params.name: heldValue
params.description: The value to pass to the finalizer for this value. This cannot be the target value.

params.name: unregisterToken
params.description: The token to pass to the unregister method to unregister the target value. If not provided, the target cannot be unregistered.

lines: register(target: WeakKey, heldValue: T, unregisterToken?: WeakKey): void;

functions.name: unregister
functions.summary: Unregisters a value from the registry. In es2023 the value can be either a symbol or an object, in previous versions only object is permissible.

params.name: unregisterToken
params.description: The token that was used as the unregisterToken argument when calling register to register the target value.
